I was invited by [Pierre Haessig](https://pierreh.eu/) and [Rémy Rigo-Mariani](https://cv.hal.science/remyrigo-mariani) to present my research during a [1-day workshop](https://gdr-macs.fr/node/5291) on Modeling and Optimization at CentraleSupélec, organized by [GDR SEEDS - GT Complex and heterogeneous systems](https://seeds.cnrs.fr/2026/01/27/reunion-gt-optimisation-save-the-date-30-03-2026/).

My slides are available [here](2026_03_30_GT_Systeme_complexes_TC.pdf).
